title: Darkest Child
description: A childlike celeste plays high notes among a barely audible harp and deep bass. In the second minute the disturbing melody is in a lower register, and strings accentuate the discordant sounds before returning to the high register. The music is excellent for a creepy dream sequence or the exposition of an unknown fantasy world. SMARTSOUND

title: At Rest
description: A recurring voice melody cascades over piano chords that sway in the breeze. Strings and horns then play the melody as the piano is slightly more forceful before settling again. It is suggestive of sadness, but with a sense of closure and peace.

title: Awkward Meeting
description: Simple piano theme drives this, but it sometimes buried under unnerving textures. 7/4 time, rubato.
feel: Dark, Eerie, Intense, Mysterious, Mystical, Suspenseful, Unnerving
